name: Maintenance help
description: Help mode entries for the Maintenance plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Maintenance
entries.text: How full the VPS is (disk, memory, swap, load), what takes the most space, and clean-up jobs you preview first and then approve on axHub.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Checks server health again straight away: alert levels, swap and the nightly run. The host part re-measures everything every 10 minutes.

entries.title: Preview
entries.text: Shows exactly what the ticked jobs would remove and how much space that frees, plus what is kept and why. Nothing is removed.

entries.title: Send for approval
entries.text: Sends the previewed clean-up to axHub as one held call. Nothing is removed until you approve it there; the VPS checks every item again before removing it.

entries.title: Clean up every night
entries.text: Each night at the set hour, sends the safe clean-up to axHub. It still waits for your approval there. Off by default.

entries.title: Maintenance settings
entries.text: Nightly auto-clean (off by default, safe jobs only, still approved on axHub), the disk and swap alert levels, and how old things must be before a clean-up takes them.

steps.say: The top shows how full the server is. Amber or red means it's time to clean up.
Tick the jobs you want, tap Preview to see what goes, then Send for approval and approve it on axHub.
